rebuttal_or_critique: I maintain my position that a rate hike is inappropriate given that the 7.44% headline inflation is driven by transient food supply shocks, while core inflation remains well-contained at 4.90%. Monetary policy must avoid overreacting to supply-side volatility, which would only serve to dampen the 7.80% GVA growth. While I acknowledge the committee's preference for maintaining the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance to anchor expectations during this period of high food inflation, I remain committed to the view that real rates are already in positive territory and sufficient. I am willing to support the consensus on the stance to ensure a unified signal to the markets, provided we do not pursue further tightening that would unnecessarily harm the post-pandemic recovery.
